items.raw_excerpt: Some prospective buyers of mass-market cars are holding off on purchases as the Land Transport Authority conducts a public consultation on merging COE categories A and B.
items.summary_en: Singapore is holding a public consultation on merging COE categories A and B. Some buyers of mass-market cars are waiting to buy until the rules are clear. Dealers say a proposed S$15,000 surcharge is too low to stop luxury buyers.

items.raw_excerpt: António Alberto Martins, conhecido como “Mina”, cortava o cabelo e fazia a barba aos habitantes da Benfeita, em Arganil. PUBLICIDADE…
items.summary_en: In the village of Benfeita, in Arganil, a barber named Antonio Alberto Martins cut hair and shaved beards for local people. He was known as "Mina", and he was paid with corn instead of money.

items.raw_excerpt: Feasting on döner kebab is a sort-of right of passage for visitors in Germany. But whether the flavour also works as a soft-drink is up for debate.
items.summary_en: In Germany, eating döner kebab is a fun ritual for many visitors. A shop in Berlin now sells a soft drink that tastes like kebab. People are not sure if the flavor works in a drink.

items.raw_excerpt: Visitors will not have to pay the 10-cent deposit on regulated beverage containers sold within the Circuit Park.
items.summary_en: Visitors at the Singapore F1 Grand Prix will not pay the 10-cent deposit on drinks sold inside the Circuit Park. The National Environment Agency said the usual BCRS deposit rule is set aside there. Fans can enjoy their drinks without the extra charge.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 F1 그랑프리를 찾은 관람객은 서킷 파크 안에서 파는 음료에 붙던 10센트 보증금을 내지 않아도 된다. 싱가포르 환경청은 이곳에 평소 음료 용기 보증금 제도를 적용하지 않는다고 밝혔다. 팬들은 추가 비용 없이 음료를 즐길 수 있다.

items.title_ko: 싱가포르 F1 그랑프리, 음료 10센트 보증금 안 받아

items.raw_excerpt: Ani Gülgün-Mayr, who has lived in Austria for 54 years, has finally become an Austrian citizen after facing a series of bureaucratic hurdles involving proof of German language proficiency and minor traffic offences.
items.summary_en: Ani Gülgün-Mayr has lived in Austria for 54 years. She finally got her Austrian citizenship after facing many bureaucratic hurdles. These included proof of German skills and small traffic fines.

items.title_en: TV presenter finally becomes Austrian citizen after 54 years
